decisions.reason: Sustained own-page presence indicates results meet aspirations, and slack allows continuing this core component.
Improved from mention to dedicated page signals satisfactory performance and increasing commitment.
Downgrade from own page to only a mention suggests results fell short of aspirations, prompting problemistic search and likely reallocation.
Consistent mention with no negative signal suggests uncertain but acceptable results, and slack allows carrying this complementary element.
Home-page prominence and launch quotes indicate results exceed aspirations, making drop very unlikely.
Merely mentioned but stable, results are uncertain rather than clearly below aspiration, so slack allows keeping the accessory.
